# EX58-EDIT-01 — Five source offices

**KEEP FL-02. Correct EC-01’s office enumeration.** This was my transcription error, not an intended new office or change to Expedition organization.

I checked the frozen `GAMEPLAY_LOOP_CANON.md`, §3, lines **101–109**. It names **Expedition Leader, Quartermaster, Routekeeper, Surgeon, and Claimant of Record** and permits one character to hold multiple offices without changing class abilities. :chatgpt-content-reference{index="0"}[Verified source excerpt](sandbox:/mnt/data/ex58_edit_01/EX58_EDIT_01_SOURCE_EXCERPT.md)

## Exact replacement wording

Replace the complete `requiredFields.offices` string with:

> Expedition Leader, Quartermaster, Routekeeper, Surgeon, and Claimant of Record, each bound to a real person; one person may hold multiple offices but not incompatible simultaneous work.

This restores **Surgeon** and **Claimant of Record**, uses the full title **Expedition Leader**, and removes **Lorekeeper** and the open-ended “other source offices” wording. It does not require five distinct people or alter the offices’ source duties.

## All affected package representations

The erroneous enumeration occurs in **exactly two locations**:

| Operation | File and location | Correction |
|---|---|---|
| **EX58-EDIT-01.1** | `EX58_FIELD_CONTRACTS.json` — `/contracts/0/requiredFields/offices`, submitted line **30**; verify `/contracts/0/id` is `EC-01` | Replace the entire string with the wording above. |
| **EX58-EDIT-01.2** | `EX58_CONTRACTS_AND_EXACT_REVIEW.md` — **EC-01 — Expedition, charter and roster**, `offices` table row, submitted line **35** | Replace its meaning cell with the identical wording. |

**No replacement is needed** in FL-02’s wording in `EX58_AUTHORING_VERDICT.md`, `EX58_AUTHORING_REGISTER.json`, or `EX58_CONFLICT_DISPOSITIONS.json`. Those representations already retain the five source offices.

## Preservation and finite acceptance

Preserve the original package, manifest, receipt, source provenance and **2,316-check report** unchanged. Apply these two replacements to the current authoring copies and record this addendum and the measured descendant hashes separately.

Acceptance requires exact JSON/Markdown wording parity, the five correct office names, unchanged multiple-office and work restrictions, and no unrelated field or source changes. **Eighteen focused source, preservation and in-memory replacement checks passed with zero failures.** These were not runtime tests or a rerun of the full conference.

**The candidate should use these five offices. No other EX58 decision changes, no further source conference is needed for this correction, and no exact-candidate approval is granted.**
